values.label: Gas supply: pipeline lateral and supply agreement
values.note: No public figure found for a data-center-scale lateral and firm supply agreement; 18 months (12 to 30) is our assumption. It gates the onsite plant's connection. No public figure for a lateral plus a firm supply agreement at this scale; the range is wide on purpose.

values.label: Accelerator order to delivery
values.note: No public allocation lead time for NVL72-class racks; 9 months (6 to 12) is our assumption, released from the basis of design. Supply Chain Management Review reports flagship GPU systems at about 8 to 16 weeks in some channels in 2026; rack-scale allocations run longer, so 9 months stays our assumption.

values.label: Transmission and line works
values.note: Utility line works are counted inside the energization wait above rather than as a separate task; a dedicated 345 kV line would add years (Grid Strategies: 6 to 10 years for large builds).
